exact_text:
This morning range will contain most of the warm bodies that failed to sit
on their hands when the news was first released. Stalk price movement
while whipsaws punish these bag holders, and then use their pain to get
on board at better entry levels.
added_conditions: stand aside while the news-driven range establishes during the first 45 minutes to two hours, then enter after whipsaws punish the initial chasers

exact_text:
Here’s the theory: Everyone who wants to buy or sell the news takes
a position within the first few hours after it hits the wires. Once they’ve
charged off the sidelines, there’s no one left to take that side of the market
added_conditions: best entry into postnews volatility comes on the afternoon following the release or two to three days later, once the initial news flow is exhausted

exact_text: News that shocks expectations can trigger buy-sell imbalances that take several days to unwind.

exact_text:
Stochastics double top breakdowns trigger reliable sell signals. Research in Motion rallies more than 15 points
in a month and tops out above 85 in June. The last phase of the uptrend carves out a lower high (1) on Stochastics, which breaks to the downside (2) just two days later.
added_conditions: best signals unfold when Stochastics makes a lower high (or higher low) near the 80-20 line and then expands in the opposite direction

exact_text:
Once you’ve located the continuation gap, wait for price to pull into a
test and place a limit order within its boundaries. The retracement, or
move against the primary trend, should run into a brick wall in the
vicinity of the gap and reverse sharply.
added_conditions: the retracement against the primary trend should reverse sharply in the vicinity of the continuation gap

exact_text:
Get familiar with classic candlestick reversals. Look for hammers
and dojis at key support or resistance. Watch out for dark cloud
cover after a big rally. Stay alert for a harami reversal after a big
bar in either direction.
added_conditions: candlestick reversal signals apply at key support or resistance and after a big rally or big bar
